summary: Iteration 7 (PayPal Bierkasse) — Backend fully verified 5/5 pytest PASS. Frontend verified end-to-end for the non-Coach path (Josh ANKERMANN) on real mobile viewport 390x844. Coach UI edit flow BLOCKED at login because michael-moser already has a persisted password from a previous iteration (not 'coach1234' — login attempt returned 'Falsches Passwort'). The Coach path is otherwise proven via backend PATCH by actor_id='michael-moser' returning 200 and GET reflecting the change. Detailed assertions: (BACKEND) GET /api/settings/bierwart returns {email:'lj-sascha@web.de'} by default; PATCH with actor_id='josh-ankermann' → 403 with detail exactly 'Nur der Trainer darf den Bierwart ändern.' and value unchanged; PATCH with actor_id='does-not-exist' → 403; PATCH with actor_id='michael-moser' and 'test-bierwart@web.de' → 200 {ok:true,email:'test-bierwart@web.de'} and subsequent GET reflects it; PATCH with 'foo', 'no-at', '' → 400 and value unchanged; final reset back to 'lj-sascha@web.de' at teardown. (FRONTEND josh-ankermann) All 200+ upcoming Trainings render testID='paypal-TR*' (visible + tappable); all 6 upcoming AWAY Spiele (T2, T3, T5, T7, T9, T12) render testID='paypal-T*' AND both testID='fahre-T*' and 'bier-T*' side-by-side; all 6 upcoming HOME Spiele (T1, T4, T6, T8, T10, T11) render NEITHER paypal, fahre, nor bier — matches spec exactly; Treffen (EV8e70f1f7) renders neither. Tapping any paypal-{id} button as Josh opens the hint modal (testID='paypal-hint-email' visible with text starting 'lj-sascha@web.de'), testID='paypal-copy-email' visible, and window.open was intercepted and called with URL 'https://www.paypal.com/myaccount/transfer/send' target='_blank' features='noopener,noreferrer'. testID='paypal-edit-open' count = 0 for Josh (correctly hidden for non-Coach). REGRESSION: Version 3.0 pill count on Login screen == 1; away-Spiel still has both fahre+bier side-by-side; Training has single bier only; cancel/delete unchanged (not retested this iter — verified in iter6). No red screens, no new console errors (pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications warnings unchanged).
